title: dockg docs page frontmatter
description: Every published page carries a title and a description. The description doubles as the LinkCard subtitle and the page meta description, so an empty one is a real defect rather than a style preference. Validated by dockg's own `validate` in .github/workflows/docs.yml, which gates the Pages deploy.

title.description: Rendered as the page H1 by Starlight. Pages must not repeat it as a body heading.

description.description: One full sentence stating what the page is for.
